name: Modern Farmhouse — raised pool (rough)
note: Farmhouse variant: pool on a stone-walled deck 1.8 m above the courtyard with broad steps up. The west wing is now an upper-floor pool house joined to the view storey, its roof valleyed into the main upper roof; bifolds face the pool with a small landing and a stair square on to the pool; windows at the south end. BBQ bench in the lower courtyard; pool pump shed in the stone base under the pool house. Lawn over most of the deck, and the whole rear of the lot (pergola corner, NE strip) at the same level; short rear eave for ground-floor sun. Earthworks figures are still the original farmhouse's.
